newsitem.title: DENMARK: Den Danske Bank offers home dealing.
newsitem.headline: Den Danske Bank offers home dealing.

text.p: Denmark's biggest bank, Den Danske, said on Monday that it had upgraded its home banking service to allow customers to trade in securities or apply for a loan from their PC.

"Most ordinary paper can be traded right away at the bank's rates but one can also buy or sell foward or within set price limits. Another new feature is the ability to apply for a loan or MasterCard through the system," the bank said in a statement.
The programme for retail customers was launched on Monday and a version for small businesses was due for release in the New Year, it added.
